title: 空間情報工学演習
subtitle: Exercises in Geoinformatics
educationalGoal: In this course, you will learn basic drawing techniques using CAD. You can create civil engineering drawings using CAD systems.
advice: In this class, students acquire the following skills through lectures and exercises: - the basics of drawings in civil engineering. - functions and how to operate CAD systems - techniques for creating civil engineering blueprints using CAD. Classes are in the CAD room. Each person must have a USB memory to save their drawings. Prints other than textbooks are distributed during class.
books: "AutoCAD LTできちんと土木図面を書く方法" (Japanese)
